question.text: If net income = Rs. 500 cr, depreciation Rs. 100 cr, CapEx Rs. 120 cr, WC change Rs. 30 cr, net borrowing Rs. 50 cr, FCFE =:

explanation.text: The Logic: FCFE = NI + Dep - CapEx - WC + Net Borrowing = 500 + 100 - 120 - 30 + 50 = 500 cr. The Trap: Other values come from sign errors. Cross-Exam Context: Same formula in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Reinvestment intensity drives FCFE volatility; smooth it over cycles.
